CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSIsNumeric

Returns True if the string can be converted to a number using the conventions of the current locale.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSIsNumeric(string)

Parameters

string
The string to test.

Returns

True (YES) or False (NO).

Usage

KoldFusion formats and parses in English (US) only (see SetLocale), and LSIsNumeric works exactly like IsNumeric. Thousands separators are not accepted: "1234.5" is a number, "1,234.5" is not. To accept money with symbols and separators, use LSIsCurrency.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = "1999|-3.14|1.5E3|1,234.5|$5|twelve">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>LSIsNumeric</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="S" LIST="#Tests#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#S#</TD><TD>#LSIsNumeric(S)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also
